description: Signals of the Business app that are not merchant-core contract events: projections and device conditions that automations in catalog/automations.v1.json listen to. Contract events (contract/event-payloads.v2.json) stay the source of truth for facts; these carry references only and are written by the cloud projections in merchant/ or by the device shell. Build section 3.

BusinessCreated.note: A business exists; setup autofill drafts its profile.

StockBelowThreshold.note: A sale or count took a product to or under its reorder level.

OrderReadyForDelivery.note: A paid order wants a delivery (N8).

PartnerStatementReceived.note: A partner's commission statement arrived; the commission check matches it.

ConnectionRestored.note: A link came back; queued items are sent, sales and payments first.

DeviceIdle.note: No touch for the idle time; the staff PIN lock engages.

MessageReceived.note: A customer message arrived in LynkChat.

DeviceHealthChecked.note: The daily device health check found something to tell the owner.

DayCloseReady.note: Closing time: the day close is prepared for the owner.

DraftCreated.note: A draft for a person to confirm (setup profile, product from photo, reorder, expiry action, suggested reply). Nothing happens until confirmed.

AlertSent.note: An inform-level message to the owner or staff (day close, cash difference, shift, negative stock, low float, device health, chat summary).

ReceiptDelivered.note: The receipt went out by the channel the customer chose (print, QR or message).

KitchenTicketRouted.note: A kitchen order reached its station screen (or the printer on Free).

DeliveryAutoRequested.note: A delivery was booked by the owner's rule, undoable until the partner accepts.

SyncRetried.note: Queued items were sent when the link came back: sales and payments first, media last.

DeviceLocked.note: The staff PIN lock engaged after idle time.

ChatRouted.note: A customer message was routed to the right staff member or queue.

CommissionChecked.note: The partner statement was matched against recorded commissions.

TrackingStepReached.note: A tracked record reached a step (catalog/tracking.v1.json, services/tracking.py). Triggers order-updates for customer steps.

TrackingSubscribed.note: The customer chose how to hear about a tracked order or delivery (a PII vault reference holds the contact, never the number itself).

TrackingUpdateSent.note: One step message to the customer, by the way they chose, in their language; held until quiet hours end when needed.

DriverUpdateAvailable.note: A LynkDriver release is out for this business's devices: level security, required or normal (BIZZ & DEVICE, 2026-11-09). Triggers driver-update-reminder.

StockReserved.note: BIZZ & DEVICE: an online Storefront checkout holds free stock for 15 minutes (core/reservations.py)

StockReservationCommitted.note: The provider confirmed the checkout's payment: the held stock is sold

StockReservationReleased.note: The payment failed or the hold timed out: the stock is free again

StockConflictFlagged.note: An in-person sale took stock a checkout was holding; never a refusal, a flag for the owner

DriverInstalled.note: LynkDriver installed on a device, online (Devices > Driver) or from the offline file

DriverUpdated.note: LynkDriver updated; overdue hardware comes back from its virtual stand-in

StaffAddedOnDevice.note: A staff member was added on the device itself by the owner or a manager, also offline (MASTER UPDATE section 3).

StaffRemovedOnDevice.note: A staff member was removed on the device itself, also offline.

StaffPinReset.note: A forgotten staff PIN was reset on the spot by the owner or a manager; never the owner's own PIN.

DuressSignalled.note: A duress PIN was used; sent quietly by the first path that appeared, for the owner's trusted contacts. Never calls the police by itself.

OfflineLimitChanged.note: The owner lowered a role's offline limit.

OverLimitApproved.note: A manager's PIN on the same device approved a void, refund or discount above the staff member's offline limit.

DeviceLockRequested.note: The owner or a manager asked for a device to be locked from afar; carried out when the device next connects.

DeviceWipeRequested.note: The owner asked for a device to be wiped, after a fresh check and after being told how many records were never sent.

DeviceWiped.note: The device destroyed its keys: its records can never be read again.

DeviceIntegrityFailed.note: The app was altered or the device is unlocked at root level; its uploads wait for the owner's review.

OfflineBackupMade.note: An encrypted backup readable only by the owner went to a second device or a memory card.

AssistActionQueued.note: LynkAssist offline: confirmed now, sealed on the device, carried out when the network returns. Never shown as done before that.

AssistActionSettled.note: A queued LynkAssist action reached the cloud: done, expired, or a conflict for the person to choose.

OwnerAsked.note: Ask the owner: a staff request above their role, with the facts, waiting for one tap.

OwnerAnswered.note: The owner confirmed or denied a staff request.

StandingPermissionSet.note: The owner let LynkAssist do a class B fix without asking, within limits; every run is still recorded, told and undoable.

AssistSwitched.note: The owner switched a LynkAssist action or area off or on for the business.

ThresholdChanged.note: The owner changed a notification threshold (low stock, cash difference, large void, refund).

DocumentSent.note: A receipt or business document went to the customer by the message channel they chose.

OwnerSummaryBuilt.note: The owner's daily or weekly summary was built from the day's records and sent by the channel the owner picked.
